tables.title: Fuel Scalar
tables.description:
Fuel-mass correction factor for this calibration table.

The guide explains that original DME copies supply map slot 1. Later slots replace only the tables that have corresponding map-switch copies; the remaining original tables stay global. The guide assigns this family to Fuel Interpolation. In this XDF, enabling Separate Fuel Scalar Interpolation chooses the scalar-specific curve instead of Fuel Interpolation. With default FF blending, factors 0 to 1 mix the active slot with FF, and factors above 1 through 2 mix FF with FF#2. The Individual FF#2 toggle changes the upper range to start from the active slot. 

Original XDF note: Kennfeld Vorsteuerungkorrektur Bank 1 KF_FRKKORRF_1. Allows for modification of specific values by Load/RPM for known rich/lean points.

Source: MHD+ Suite Tuning Guide, N55/MEVD applicability, pages 14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21.

tables.title: Enable Separate Fuel Scalar Interpolation
tables.description:
Chooses a separate blend curve for Fuel Scalar.

The guide identifies Fuel Scalar Interpolation as a separate category where supported. In this N55 XDF, the enable byte at 1 selects those scalar-specific curves; otherwise Fuel Interpolation also blends Fuel Scalar. That byte-level behavior is documented by the XDF's original note. This does not separate startup/warmup compensation, which follows its own ethanol/temperature table.

Original XDF note: Setting to 1 will use the Fuel Scalar Interpolation tables for blending Fuel Scalar values. Otherwise the Fuel Interpolation tables are used for Fuel Scalar as well.

Source: MHD+ Suite Tuning Guide, N55/MEVD applicability, pages 18, 22.

tables.title: Static Ethanol Content (Map 1)
tables.description:
Fixed ethanol-percentage input for this map slot.

Zero leaves this override inactive. A value above zero substitutes for, or overrides, the sensor ethanol percentage for the selected slot. Ethanol Content (Active) shows the percentage actually used; Ethanol Content (CAN) continues to show the sensor reading, or zero when no sensor is installed. Static ethanol also activates the start/warmup compensation path. A slot can keep its own running tables by using zero interpolation factors while still using ethanol startup compensation.

Original XDF note: Setting to a value > 0 will override (or substitute) the E% value coming from your CANBUS ECA.

Source: MHD+ Suite Tuning Guide, N55/MEVD applicability, pages 17, 22, 24.

tables.title: Load Interpolation (Map 1)
tables.description:
Ethanol blend factor for the load/boost-control group in this slot.

The MEVD grouping includes the boost ceilings, compressor/turbine-power map, WGDC P/D correction tables, Commanded WGDC, knock-related load ceiling, and maximum clutch torque per gear. The factor is indexed by Ethanol Content (Active). Under default blending, 0 uses the active slot, 1 uses FF, and 2 uses FF#2; intermediate values blend between those endpoints. Above 1, the usual equation is FF + (FF#2 - FF) * (factor - 1). Enable Individual FF#2 Blending changes that upper-range starting point to the active slot. These curves are independent for each map slot and table group.

Source: MHD+ Suite Tuning Guide, N55/MEVD applicability, pages 18, 19, 20, 21.

tables.title: Fuel Interpolation (Map 1)
tables.description:
Ethanol blend factor for the running-fuel group in this slot.

The grouping includes main fuel, spool fuel, fuel correction, and Fuel Scalar unless a separate scalar interpolation curve is enabled. It does not govern the start/warmup ethanol compensation table. The factor is indexed by Ethanol Content (Active). Under default blending, 0 uses the active slot, 1 uses FF, and 2 uses FF#2; intermediate values blend between those endpoints. Above 1, the usual equation is FF + (FF#2 - FF) * (factor - 1). Enable Individual FF#2 Blending changes that upper-range starting point to the active slot. These curves are independent for each map slot and table group.

Source: MHD+ Suite Tuning Guide, N55/MEVD applicability, pages 18, 19, 20, 21.

tables.title: Fuel Scalar Interpolation (Map 1)
tables.description:
Separate ethanol blend factor for Fuel Scalar in this slot.

This XDF uses the curve only when Enable Separate Fuel Scalar Interpolation is 1; otherwise the running-fuel interpolation curve also controls Fuel Scalar. The factor is indexed by Ethanol Content (Active). Under default blending, 0 uses the active slot, 1 uses FF, and 2 uses FF#2; intermediate values blend between those endpoints. Above 1, the usual equation is FF + (FF#2 - FF) * (factor - 1). Enable Individual FF#2 Blending changes that upper-range starting point to the active slot. These curves are independent for each map slot and table group.

Original XDF note: only used if the "Enable Separate Fuel Scalar Interpolation" table is set to 1. (otherwise Fuel Interpolation is also used for blending Fuel Scalar tables)

Source: MHD+ Suite Tuning Guide, N55/MEVD applicability, pages 18, 19, 20, 21.

Above 1, the usual equation is FF + (FF#2 - FF) * (factor - 1). Enable Individual FF#2 Blending changes that upper-range starting point to the active slot.
